description: Region::Guard is the only region whose predicate.subject is never read: the interpreter ignores it (src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs region_hit), the graph builder must special-case it out of the demand fold (src/dispatch_matrix/mod.rs charge_node), and the producer mints an input subject that exists only to carry guards on a plan that declares no inputs (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs guard_subject), which is why PlanInputs.count needs a comment saying it is not subjects.len(). One idea, "a guard is a question about no subject", is spelled as a subject plus three reminders not to believe it. Fix is a data-model change: a test node that carries a guard without a subject (RegionPredicate is subject-mandatory today). Guards become code under fz-21x.24 and Region::Guard leaves with them; if that lands first this closes with it.
title: A guard question carries a subject nobody reads
